+def test_testclient_preserves_http_response_debug_info(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None:
+    arbitrary_debug_info = {"detail": "debug information", "values": [1, 2, 3]}
+    template = object()
+    context = {"request": object()}
+    template_debug_info = {"template": template, "context": context, "extra": "debug information"}
+
+    async def app(scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        debug_info = template_debug_info if scope["path"] == "/template" else arbitrary_debug_info
+        await send({"type": "http.response.debug", "info": debug_info})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.start", "status": 200})
+        await send({"type": "http.response.body", "body": b"Hello, world!"})
+
+    client = test_client_factory(app)
+    response = client.get("/")
+    assert response.extensions["http.response.debug"] == arbitrary_debug_info
+
+    response = client.get("/template")
+    assert response.extensions["http.response.debug"] == template_debug_info
+    assert response.template is template  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert response.context is context  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+
